product.name: Danfoss Randall AVDO15 15mm Straight Automatic By-Pass Valve
product.description: The AVDO range of automatic bypass valves can be used as either differential pressure controls or to provide a minimum flow through a system.Many boiler manufacturers are now insisting that a bypass be fitted in all installations to ensure that the volume of water circulating through the boiler does not fall to below a predefinedminimum, regardless of the load on the system. Recognising the energy efficiency advantage of such controls the Building Regulations now require in both new-build and boiler replacementcontexts, where a bypass is specified by the boiler manufacturer, that an automatic bypass is fitted. Automatic bypass valves improve systemefficiency by opening only when there is a need to bypass water, this usually occurs at times of part load when radiator thermostats in the system are partly closed and water flow around the boiler is restricted. In addition to ensuring adequate flow around the boiler, automatic bypass valves also prevent pump pressure from climbingsignificantly above design levels, thus reducing the risk of noise in the system.Available in a variety of sizes, the capacity of this range of valves is very high with large but linear changes in water throughput for relatively small increases in differential pressure. Thisallows a 15mm valve to be used in situations where 22mm valves are normally required. Product Features Easy to set, self acting flow controller Opens on rising differential pressure DN15, DN20, DN25 Setting range of 0.05 to 0.5 bar Internal/External thread variants Improves system efficiency Maintains minimum flow rates through boiler and pump Essential in low water content boiler systems Supplied with a 1 year guarantee from the manufacturer

This configuration features 1 x front panel and 1 x side/end panel connected by wall-mounted support arms, leaving a 500mm walk-through gap. product.name: Delphi Accents Chrome Wet Room Screen with Hinged Return 1200mm x 700mm (inc Slate Grey Tray)
product.description: Accents Chrome Wet Room Screen with Hinged Return (inc Slate Grey Tray) The Accents collection of glass screens are an affordable luxury - with wet room designs and styles that were once confined to exclusive resorts or boutique hotels. This configuration of the Accents walk-in mixes a fixed front panel with a hinged return panel, creating an additional barrier that aids with water deflection. The screen is complemented by classy polished chrome effect fittings, and comes built to an impressive standard: 8mm easy-clean glass standing at 1950mm tall. product.name: Delphi Dive Brushed Brass Bath Filler Tap
product.description: Delphi Dive Brushed Brass Bath Filler TapThe Dive bath filler keeps everything low and wide: two slim pillars on their own rounded backplates, each capped with a flat blade lever, bridged by a spout that sits just 70mm above the bath deck. That spout is an open channel rather than an enclosed pipe, so the water runs along a visible trough and drops into the bath in a broad sheet instead of a jet. The brushed brass carries a fine directional grain that keeps the gold soft rather than showy, and it works particularly well against wood, warm stone and deeper wall colours. Each handle turns on a quarter turn ceramic disc valve, going from off to fully open in a quarter of a rotation, which gives separate hot and cold control without the winding of an older compression tap. This is a high pressure fitting - 1.0 bar minimum, delivering 18.3 litres a minute at that pressure and 26.2 at 2 bar - so it fills quickly on a combi or unvented supply, while a gravity-fed tank would need a pump.
